appearance_facts.fact: Bold heading reads 'Reduced Screening Referrals Across Hospitals from 2012 to 2023'.

A single orange line spans 2012–2023; it starts low (~1200), rises to a 2014 peak (~1650), dips in 2015, climbs to ~2450 by 2018, plateaus through 2020, jumps to ~3250 in 2021, peaks in 2022 (~3500), then falls slightly in 2023.
The 2023 point is the rightmost marker; it sits below the 2022 peak and above the 3200 gridline, near the top of the chart.
